models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.system_ram_min: up to 512GB GPU memory per M5 Ultra Mac Studio

engines.hardware: four M5 Ultra Mac Studios over Thunderbolt 5 (Apple's own test; two Mac Studios hold the 493GB 4-bit model)
engines.quant: 4-bit, about 493GB of weights across the cluster; Apple's speed figure is >36 tok/s from four M5 Ultra Mac Studios (two hold the model); encoding is not named in the post

models.why: Meta's 816B/42B-active Muse Spark Open needs two M5 Ultra Mac Studios just to hold its ~493GB 4-bit weights, and Apple's own >36 tok/s figure was measured on four of them over Thunderbolt 5 — a desktop-local run only at workstation-cluster scale.
